design_rule: Slots define narrative functions and plausibility constraints. They are not historical people until instantiated in adaptation-only prose.

substories.local_question: 一个靠本人判断维持质量的系统，怎样真正长出第二判断者？
家乡体制生活真实有效以后，怎样区分满足与惯性？
多年后终于进入更高平台，真实工作是否配得上等待？
一个研究者是否真能让负面证据迅速结束自己刚开始喜欢的问题？
在不离开组织的情况下，岗位价值能不能被重新做出一点空间？
主动降薪换来的生活改善，能否与较慢学习速度长期共存？
保护一个慢问题两年后，谁有权说它不再值得？
扩大组织影响力时，怎样不重新掉回全天候响应？
个人判断能力什么时候才真的变成别人可独立使用的方法？

guest_slots.needed_role: SOE technical colleague with enough domain exposure to take common exception judgments but lower seniority than Zhou
plausibility_constraints: must actually handle live cases
must have manager permission to judge
cannot be written as incompetent foil
must have own reason to want judgment authority

guest_slots.needed_role: mid-level public-sector supervisor who values reliability and continuity but also knows promotion and learning limits
plausibility_constraints: cannot promise promotion
must be constrained by formal staffing and task allocation
should have a legitimate reason to value Gao's steadiness

guest_slots.needed_role: research-support project lead at Luo's second platform, responsible for both project quality and coordination load
plausibility_constraints: must own real project scope
cannot know Luo's entire prior career story
has incentives for delivery that can conflict with Luo's content ideals

guest_slots.needed_role: younger researcher or student participating in the small research exploration
plausibility_constraints: must contribute real work or questions
cannot exist only to admire Tang
should experience both benefit and pressure from Tang's high standards

guest_slots.needed_role: public-institution supervisor with authority to assign a bounded cross-department task but not redesign He's entire position
plausibility_constraints: authority limited to task assignment
must balance fairness and workload across staff
may value He partly because she is dependable, creating both opportunity and risk

guest_slots.needed_role: medical/business-side collaborator in Song's second pharma role who owns domain requirements but depends on statistical judgment
plausibility_constraints: must have domain expertise Song lacks
must need delivery clarity rather than model sophistication
can disagree legitimately over speed, uncertainty and usable conclusions

guest_slots.needed_role: regional university colleague who sees evaluation and workload pressures differently from Lin
plausibility_constraints: cannot simply embody KPI villainy
should have a rational strategy for surviving evaluation
may sincerely think Lin is wasting scarce research time

guest_slots.needed_role: counterpart manager from another team who needs fast decisions and can pressure Chen's bounded governance design
plausibility_constraints: must face real deadlines
cannot be maliciously demanding
should bear consequences if governance is too slow

guest_slots.needed_role: technically capable but non-specialist user attempting to apply Xu's verification framework without Xu present
plausibility_constraints: must be competent enough that failure is informative
must be allowed to reach a different but defensible stopping judgment
cannot exist merely to prove Xu right

instantiation_rule: Names, ages, detailed resumes, family background and voice are created only when a scene needs the slot; every instantiated guest must pass v14 reverse plausibility audit before prose use.
